captain = the player who leads the team on the field
substitute = a player who comes on for someone else
bench = the seats for players who are not on the field
kit = the clothes a team wears for a match
strip = a team's match colours and shirt design
football boots = special shoes for football or rugby
shin pads = plastic guards that protect your lower legs
helmet = a hard hat that protects your head
goggles = protective glasses for swimming or skiing
racket = the thing you use to hit the ball in tennis or badminton
bat = a wooden stick used to hit the ball in cricket or table tennis
net = the mesh that divides a court or is a goal in some sports
goal = the frame you score into; a point scored that way
whistle = the object a referee blows to stop or start play
scoreboard = the board that shows the score
league = a group of clubs that play each other over a season
cup final = the last match of a knockout competition
semi-final = a match whose winner goes to the final
qualifier = a match you must win to enter a bigger competition
Olympic Games = the world's biggest multi-sport event, every four years
